$comment: Storm mode (issue #23). capHours: the longest horizon safe hours are quoted for. stableGridMinutes: minutes of grid back before the storm ends (plan §9.2). minIntervalMinutes: one family message per transition and person within this interval. epsBaseLoadW: what the home draws on the EPS besides the safe-room split (fridge, router, lights; assumption to calibrate on the plant). occupantGainW: sensible heat of a resting adult in the safe room. inApp: the simulated phone's inbox.
